# Relic-density input

`monotop_vector_nom_relic_density_scan.txt` is copied without modification from
the CERN GitLab project `kit-cn-cms/monotop-datacards-final`, branch
`law-setup`, commit `b81705b9fb1499ccc94a69baecaf3f63c29484cb`:

`store/external/relic_densities/monotop_vector_nom_relic_density_scan.txt`

SHA-256:
`fddda2d232c4eceda905364b8cc941d639372cd8dd26c63658d07defde141f45`

The plotting workflow reads columns 2--4 as mediator mass, dark-matter mass,
and relic density, and overlays the nominal-vector constraint
`Omega_chi h^2 = 0.12`.
